text:
incident-bot: ALERT — synthetic canary cluster 'canary-webchecks-us-west-2' failing checks for route /api/v1/health (5m failure) -> firing pager (PD: PD-23456). status: 5xx and connection timeouts. Example failure rate 18%.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: incident PD-23456 created and triggered. Escalation policy: infra-oncall. Paging alex_ops.

alex_ops: acked in PD. I'm looking. Any immediate customer reports?

jess_support: Not seeing customer tickets yet, but observability shows increased 500s for a few small customers routed through us-west-2. No major public outage page.

maria_oncall: Repro from my laptop: curl -v https://us-west-2.redwood.example/api/v1/health returns HTTP/1.1 503 and sometimes connection reset.

sam_sre: Copying probe logs from the failing canary job: ```
[2026-03-13T22:03:45Z] GET /api/v1/health -> 503 (upstream error)
[2026-03-13T22:03:46Z] GET /api/v1/health -> connection reset by peer
[2026-03-13T22:04:01Z] Probe latency 1.8s (p95 2.1s)
[2026-03-13T22:04:15Z] Retrying -> 503
```

sam_sre: Looks like upstream NGINX on pool-wnode-*-a is returning 503s intermittently. Could be overloaded or a config flake.

alex_ops: I see elevated CPU on an autoscaled node group for inference-proxy in us-west-2. Could be memory pressure leading to process restarts. K8s events show OOMKills on proxy pods around 22:02Z.

maria_oncall: Can we failover canary checks to eu-west-1 temporarily while we triage? That'll stop noisy pages and reduce PD noise.

sam_sre: Steps: 1) pause synthetic job in us-west-2 2) scale proxy pool down then up to recycle 3) cordon and drain suspected bad nodes 4) monitor. I'll run the scale/roll now.

alex_ops: Doing scale + roll. Command: ```kubectl -n infra scale deployment inference-proxy --replicas=6 --context=us-west-2``` then `kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-proxy -n infra`.

(automated deploy-bot): deployment/inference-proxy restarted: 6 -> 6 replicas rolled, 2 pods recreated. Healthchecks returning green for restarted pods.

maria_oncall: Paused canary job in datadog for us-west-2: job id canary-webchecks-us-west-2 paused at 22:10Z. Switching active canary to eu-west-1.

jess_support: Customer impact: small subset (customers A, C) saw transient 5xxs on model inference endpoints for ~10–15 minutes. No data loss. Recommend proactive emails only if they escalate.

liu_prod: Opening a mitigation ticket to add an automatic restart trigger for proxy OOMs to the runbook. Assigning to infra team for follow-up.

sam_sre: Observed error rates dropped to baseline after restart and canary job pause. We'll keep canary in eu-west-1 for 1 hour to validate.

alex_ops: Handing off to maria for next 4h watch. Notes: suspected cause — sudden memory growth in proxy when a specific request pattern hit KV cache eviction. Action items: collect heap profiles, add memory limits bump, add OOM alert to runbook.

maria_oncall: Ack handoff. I'll monitor and escalate back if errors reappear. Adding postmortem owner: sam_sre.

pagerduty-bot: PD-23456 acknowledged by alex_ops. Status: acknowledged -> monitoring.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated: canary paused, proxies rolled, traffic routed to fallback region. No major customer-facing outage. Postmortem assigned: infra/sre (sam_sre). Follow-up actions: update runbooks, add canary failover automation, add heap profiling to proxy image.

alex_ops: closing thread here unless maria sees regression. Thanks all :thanks: 

maria_oncall: closing notes: will create a follow-up ticket with heap dumps and perf traces, target ETA for postmortem draft EOD tomorrow.
